name: double-shift-search-tabs
description: JetBrains-style Search Everywhere for VS Code: double Shift opens one palette for files, symbols, actions and text.
author: xelblch <https://github.com/xelblch>

commands.title: Double Shift Search Tabs: Open Palette
Double Shift Search Tabs: Next Tab
Double Shift Search Tabs: Previous Tab

doubleShiftSearchTabs.useSelectionAsQuer.description: Automatically pre-fill the search palette with the text currently selected in the active editor.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.rememberLastTab.description: Reopen the search palette on the tab (All, Classes, Files, Symbols, Actions, Text) that was last used. When disabled, the palette always opens on All. Filters (match case, whole word, regex, file mask, non-project items) are remembered either way.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.rememberLastQuery.description: Reopen the search palette with the last query, selected so typing replaces it. The search runs again, so the results are current. A selection in the editor still wins when useSelectionAsQuery is on.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.maxRecentFiles.description: The maximum number of recent files to store and display at the top of the search palette.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.excludeExtensions.description: A list of file extensions that should be completely ignored when performing a deep text search.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.defaultExcludes.markdownDescription: Hide common dependency, build, cache and tool folders: `node_modules`, `.venv`, `venv`, `bower_components`, `dist`, `build`, `out`, `.next`, `.nuxt`, `.output`, `coverage`, `__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `.mypy_cache`, `.tox`, `.cache`, `.gradle`, `.git`, `.idea`, `.vscode-test`, `.omc`, `.playwright-mcp`. `#doubleShiftSearchTabs.excludeFolders#` adds to this list. The Include Non-Project Items button still shows everything.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.excludeFolders.description: Folder names to hide from search results, on top of files.exclude, search.exclude and the built-in list (doubleShiftSearchTabs.defaultExcludes). Names may use * and ? wildcards, e.g. "gtaapi-tec-*" to hide git worktree copies.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.maxFiles.description: The maximum number of files to index for the search palette. Acts as a safety cap for very large workspaces.

doubleShiftSearchTabs.deprioritizedFolde.description: A list of folder names (e.g. vendor, Pods) whose contents are ranked lower in search results instead of being hidden entirely.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
